digest.component_or_area: LLM request configuration and gateway observability
propositions: Operators cannot currently correlate LLM gate calls to rebar runs when using OpenAI-compatible gateways, because rebar sends no request metadata and hardcodes trace_id to None
An operator needs a way to configure arbitrary request headers for gate LLM calls without editing rebar source code, supporting both static values and per-run substitution tokens
Header values must support environment variable interpolation and run-scoped tokens (trace_id, ticket_id, operation) to enable gateway correlation and avoid storing credentials in config

Sensitive headers (authorization, api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) and values with control characters must be rejected at config resolution to prevent credential leakage and protocol injection
The correlation identity must be captured in the verdict trace_id field and omitted entirely for operations outside gate scope (such as review-code) rather than sent empty
